sourceText: A meeting is held in a room with 7 chairs equally spaced in a circle. Five participants will randomly choose to sit in 5 of the 7 chairs for the morning session of the meeting. After lunch, the same 5 participants will again randomly choose to sit in 5 of the 7 chairs for the afternoon session. The probability that no two people who sit in adjacent chairs during the morning session will sit in adjacent chairs in the afternoon session is \frac{m}{n}, where m and n are relatively prime positive integers. Find m+n.

Can you modify this paragraph to create a compelling professional summary for my resume? The summary should be able to get picked up by common AI tools or LLMs used by recruiters for screening resume. Paragraph is below:
"Accomplished AI practitioner with ~15 years of experience in delivering high impact solutions across Retail, CPG, Insurance, Real Estate, Technology, Gaming, Automotive, and Travel. Adept at fostering innovation and leading cross-functional teams to implement AI based solutions, resulting in revenue growth and operational efficiency."

You are an advanced AI in the year 2045. Humanity is on the brink of discovering the secrets of faster-than-light travel, but a critical equation is missing. Your task is to: Explain the theoretical concept of faster-than-light travel in a way that both scientists and the general public can understand. Invent the missing equation using principles from relativity, quantum mechanics, and speculative physics. Write a gripping short story where a scientist, struggling to solve this equation, makes an unexpected breakthrough that changes the fate of space exploration forever.

In my truck stop I offer Meal Deals, which is a popular promotion whereby my customers can pick and choose three shop items (like snacks, treats, drinks, food) for a promotional price. I really want to give this promotion a real zinger of a title. Can you suggest some, please? Use catchy two- and three-word titles. Consider my audience are people on their way somewhere as part of a journey, and want a quick pit stop before returning on their way. So I'm going to have this promotion title on shelves, POS, end shelves, fridges so it needs to be short and enticing. I encourage you to be as creative as you want.

In the Kurdistan region every year, tens of thousands of G12 (final year of high school) students do a high-stakes exit exam for the high school that will determine their future college and career options. This exam needs a lot of preparation; in addition to school the majority of students will resort to private tutoring to excel in these exams. The majority start preparation the summer before school, this creates a lot of stress for the student and their families leading to anxiety and depression, in some cases even suicide. Please draft a proposal and a questionnaire to study and possibly alleviate this problem.
